messages:
maya: heads-up — hit a quota attribution weirdness in staging when requests are proxied via project-SA impersonation. metrics show tokens billed to org-A instead of org-B.
oliver: can you paste the router logs? sounds like the origin header might be dropped during internal handoff
maya: log snippet: `x-auth-origin: project:proj-b`, `x-impersonate-sa: sa-analytics@orgA` — router receives impersonation but we see billing mapped to orgA; i think `x-auth-origin` trimmed at auth-proxy
samir: authz-proxy currently strips all `x-` headers by default unless whitelisted. we debated a header whitelist before.
zoe: we ran into similar for bulk-ingest rollouts. UX question: should console show the "originating org" or the "execution/billing org"? customers expect both sometimes.
maya: ideally both: show "originator (asserted)" + "executor (token)" and which org was billed. cc @deploy-bot
deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0113 — routing/attribution-mismatch (severity: low)
oliver: for quota enforcement we currently use `claims.project` inside JWT. when token exchange/impersonation happens, the token reflects the exec SA. do we prefer an `Origin` header when present?
samir: security risk: arbitrary clients can spoof `x-auth-origin`. only allow it if we have a signed attestation that the proxy can verify, e.g. `x-origin-assertion` JWS issued by trusted gateway.
maya: proposal: add signed attestation header + TTL. router verifies and records `origin` if assertion valid. console shows "Origin (asserted) / Execution (token)". if attestation missing -> mark as UNVERIFIED.
zoe: telemetry needs: new histogram `attribution_mismatch` and per-route ratio. alert if >0.5% for 5m in prod. also track `attribution_verified_ratio`.
oliver: rollout plan: behind feature-flag. default keep current behavior. beta for dedicated customers and opt-in via console toggle: "prefer asserted origin when attested"
samir: API change: new header `x-origin-assertion: <jws>` and new optional token claim `orig_org`. update authz-proxy to verify signatures against our gateway public keys, and add e2e tests.
maya: test matrix: 1) SA impersonation + no assertion -> bill to executor org. 2) SA impersonation + valid assertion -> bill to origin org. 3) malformed assertion -> treat as no assertion.
zoe: i'll wire dashboards: add panels for `billing_discrepancy_count`, `attribution_verified_ratio`, `attribution_mismatch_pct_by_route`. also expose a JSON export for audits.
maya: i'll draft SPEC PR describing header, attestation format, failure modes, and console UX states (asserted/verified/unverified).
oliver: sounds good. one more thing: logging — include `orig:<org>|exec:<org>` fields in access logs for easy joins.
samir: note: must update telemetry docs and retention for these new fields (PII? only org ids).
maya: thanks team, i'll open the PR and tag everyone. planning to ship feature-flag rollout next quarter.
oliver: cheers :thumbsup:"
